main_text.l: Sacris, atque sacro Numinis impetu Divina
ambis stabilem, quam nequè secula Delebunt
constans pietas, quòd calidæ preces Divinam
Animo lubente, sed invitâ Minervâ posuit

page.notes: Verse lines are printed with line breaks; indented lines are shown as separate lines within the stanza paragraph. Ornamental border at top omitted. The poem's printed lines are transcribed in order; the closing "Pro Amico" and the signature are set in italic/small capitals. FINIS is set in spaced italic capitals.
